title: Alembic env.py imports only Base without triggering model registration
description: The generated alembic/env.py imports 'from janus_core.models.base import Base' to get target_metadata, but does not import the model modules (auth.py, employee.py, communication.py). Without those imports, the models never register their table metadata on Base, and 'alembic revision --autogenerate' produces empty migrations even though 36 tables are defined.
root_cause: Phase 3.2 Sub-Agent B generates the Alembic setup with a minimal import that gets Base for metadata. The sub-agent does not know that SQLAlchemy requires model modules to be imported for their table definitions to register on the declarative base's metadata. The models/__init__.py re-exports everything, so importing from janus_core.models instead of janus_core.models.base would fix this.
recommendation: In Phase 3.2 Sub-Agent B's Alembic section, change the generated import to: 'from <package>.models import Base' (importing from the models package __init__, not from base.py directly). Add a comment: '# Import from models package to trigger model registration on Base.metadata'. Also add to the Verification Gate (Phase 4): run 'alembic check' or 'alembic revision --autogenerate --dry-run' to verify autogenerate detects the expected tables.
affected_phase: Phase 3.2 — Sub-Agent Path: Infrastructure Architect (Database Migration section)
